# AI roaming reference

The components that make monsters wander, patrol, attack on sight and run home when pulled too far. For how to use it, see [AI roaming](../modules/ai-roaming.md).

## VtRoaming

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → AI → VtRoaming**.

Wander, patrol and leash behaviour for monsters. Attached by `VtUnit` when the definition's `VtUnitDefinition.roamRadius` is above 0, or by a `VtMobSpawner` that carries a `VtPatrolRoute`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roam Radius (`roamRadius`) | `float` | 8 | ≥ 0 | Radius around home the unit wanders within. 0 = no wandering (patrol routes still work). |
| Leash Radius (`leashRadius`) | `float` | 25 | ≥ 0 | Distance from home past which the unit drops aggro and runs back invulnerably. 0 = no leash. |
| Idle Min Seconds (`idleMinSeconds`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0 | Shortest pause between walks, in seconds. |
| Idle Max Seconds (`idleMaxSeconds`) | `float` | 5 | ≥ 0 | Longest pause between walks, in seconds. |
| Roam Speed Multiplier (`roamSpeedMultiplier`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0.1 | Move speed multiplier while wandering or patrolling. |
| Return Speed Multiplier (`returnSpeedMultiplier`) | `float` | 2.5 | ≥ 0.1 | Move speed multiplier while running home after a leash break. |
| Arrive Threshold (`arriveThreshold`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0.1 | Distance under which a destination counts as reached. |
| Patrol Route (`patrolRoute`) | [VtPatrolRoute](#vtpatrolroute) | None |  | Optional waypoint route. When set the unit walks it in order instead of wandering, and home follows along so the leash stays relative to the route. Usually assigned by a VtMobSpawner. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtRoaming.RoamState State { get; }` | Current state. |
| `Vector3 Home { get; }` | The position the leash and wandering are measured from. Captured at `Initialize`; moves along a patrol route; change it with `SetHome`. |
| `Vector3 CurrentDestination { get; }` | Where the unit is currently walking or returning to. |
| `VtPatrolRoute PatrolRoute { get; set; }` | Waypoint route to follow instead of wandering. Null wanders. Setting it restarts at the first waypoint. |
| `bool UsesMover { get; }` | True when a `VtTopDownClickToMove` sibling carries out the movement. |
| `event Action<VtRoaming.RoamState, VtRoaming.RoamState> OnStateChanged` | Fires on every state transition with (previous, next). |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings, capture home, seed the first idle pause. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `void SetHome(Vector3 newHome)` | Move the home position, for example after a teleport or respawn. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the state machine by `deltaTime` seconds. Authority-only. |
| `protected virtual void StepTowards(Vector3 destination, float speed, float deltaTime)` | Move the transform one step toward `destination` at `speed` units per second. Only used when no `VtTopDownClickToMove` sibling exists. The base version is a straight line on the ground plane; override it to route through your own movement. |

## VtHostileAi

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → AI → VtHostileAi**.

Makes a unit behave like a monster: it attacks hostile units that come inside its definition's `VtUnitDefinition.aggroRange`, and it fights back whenever something else hands it a target (a threat table, a taunt, your own code calling `VtCombatEngagement.SetTarget`).

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scan Interval (`scanInterval`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between scans for hostile units inside the definition's Aggro Range while idle. |
| Line Of Sight Mask (`lineOfSightMask`) | `LayerMask` | Nothing |  | Layers that block line of sight. Leave empty to notice hostiles through walls. |
| Eye Height (`eyeHeight`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Height above the unit's position the sight check is cast from and to. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<IVtAttackable> OnTargetAcquired` | Fires when the scan picks a new target on sight. Not fired for targets handed in from outside (threat, taunt). |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache sibling components. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance by `deltaTime` seconds: keep the basic attack armed against the current target, or scan for one. Authority-only. |
| `IVtAttackable FindNearestHostile()` | The closest attackable unit of a hostile faction inside the definition's aggro range, with line of sight when `lineOfSightMask` is set. Null when there is none or the aggro range is 0. |

## VtPatrolRoute

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → AI → VtPatrolRoute**.

An ordered list of waypoints a `VtRoaming` unit walks instead of wandering. Place it in the scene, drag waypoint transforms into `waypoints`, or leave the list empty and parent empty objects under it: children are used in hierarchy order. Assign the route on a `VtMobSpawner` or set `VtRoaming.PatrolRoute` from code.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Waypoints (`waypoints`) | `Transform`[] | Empty | Waypoints in walking order. Leave empty to use this object's children in hierarchy order. |
| Loop (`loop`) | `bool` | On | After the last waypoint continue at the first. Off walks the route back and forth. |
| Gizmo Color (`gizmoColor`) | `Color` | `#33CCFFE6` | Gizmo colour for the route in the Scene view. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `int Count { get; }` | Number of waypoints, explicit or from children. |
| `Vector3 GetPoint(int index)` | World position of waypoint `index`, clamped into range. Returns this object's position when the route is empty. |
| `void Advance(ref int index, ref int direction)` | Step `index` to the next waypoint. `direction` is +1 or -1 and flips at the ends when `loop` is off. |
| `void SetWaypoints(Transform[] points)` | Replace the explicit waypoint list from code. |

## Enums

### VtRoaming.RoamState

State machine values, readable for animation and debug overlays.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Idle` | Waiting for the next walk. |
| `Walking` | Walking to a wander point or patrol waypoint. |
| `InCombat` | Chasing the engagement target. |
| `Returning` | Leash broken: invulnerable and running home. |
